avoid_supplements.name: Nitrates (organic nitrates, amyl nitrite)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Severe hypotension and cardiovascular collapse via synergistic vasodilation
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; do not co-administer under any circumstances

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces sildenafil plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, switch to alternative or monitor for reduced efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Ritonavir and other potent CYP3A4 inhibitors
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP3A4 increases sildenafil levels significantly, increasing adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Use alternative HIV protease inhibitor or reduce sildenafil dose; monitor closely

caution_supplements.name: L-arginine
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive vasodilatory effects; may enhance hypotensive response
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; counsel on possible enhanced effects

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce sildenafil concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; no dose adjustment typically needed

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Possible mild antiplatelet and vasodilatory additive effects
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on potential enhanced vasodilation; monitor if bleeding risk present

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays sildenafil absorption and reduces peak plasma concentration by up to 29%; delays onset by 60+ minutes
avoid_foods.action: Administer sildenafil on empty stomach or with light meal; counsel timing 30-60 minutes before activity

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase sildenafil levels moderately; effect variable and individual-dependent
caution_foods.action: Counsel to limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects (flushing, headache, hypotension)

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (moderate-heavy consumption)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive vasodilatory and hypotensive effects; increased risk of syncope and cardiac events
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol intake; counsel on risk of orthostatic hypotension, especially with heavy use

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular status, especially in patients with underlying cardiac disease, hypotension, or concurrent vasodilatory therapy. Assess for headache, flushing, dyspepsia, and visual disturbances as common adverse effects that may be exacerbated by food/supplement interactions.
